hunks.baseline: The sound of footsteps crossing ground covered in blood, rainwater, and countless corpses rang out with unusual weight.
hunks.sol: Footsteps crossed ground covered in blood, rainwater, and countless corpses. Each one landed with a peculiar weight.

hunks.baseline: No—even on this vast battlefield, where friend and foe together numbered well over a hundred thousand, his presence was utterly overwhelming.
hunks.sol: No—even on this vast battlefield, where friend and foe together numbered well over a hundred thousand, his presence was overwhelming.

hunks.baseline: Qi spread through the space with every step he took.
hunks.sol: Qi spread through the space around him with every step.

hunks.baseline: Even now, rain and arrows poured unceasingly from the sky, only to bounce off an invisible barrier of energy. The Dark Heaven followers charging toward the collapsed western wall split to either side and prostrated themselves.
hunks.sol: Rain and arrows poured unceasingly from the sky, only to bounce off an invisible barrier of energy. The Dark Heaven followers charging toward the collapsed western wall parted to either side and prostrated themselves.

hunks.baseline: As if bewitched, they murmured a creed of eight words.
hunks.sol: As if bewitched, they murmured their eight-character creed.

hunks.baseline: Reverence offered to the true ruler of this world—their god—and permitted only to the six Apostles he had personally favored.
hunks.sol: Reverence offered to the true ruler of this world, their god—and permitted only to the six Apostles he had personally favored.

hunks.baseline: The creed, begun with a few quiet murmurs, soon became a tremendous roar that swallowed the battlefield.
hunks.sol: What began as a few quiet murmurs soon became a roar that swallowed the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: A ripple became a current, then a wave that swept in every direction.
hunks.sol: A ripple became a current, then a wave sweeping in every direction.

hunks.baseline: The pounding rain, the thunder flashing between the dark clouds, even the arrows raining down to fill the sky—nothing could stop the creed pouring from their lips.
hunks.sol: The pounding rain, the thunder flashing between dark clouds, even the arrows filling the sky—nothing could drown out the creed pouring from their lips.

hunks.baseline: Blades flashed, and heads sprang up all over the battlefield.
hunks.sol: Blades flashed, and heads flew across the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: And that wasn’t all.
hunks.sol: Nor was that all.

hunks.baseline: Arms and legs severed from their bodies plunged into the mud. Arrows streaking in like flashes of light buried themselves in backs and waists.
hunks.sol: Severed arms and legs plunged into the mud. Arrows streaked in like flashes of light and buried themselves in backs and waists.

hunks.baseline: Even when their limbs were cut off, even when arrowheads pierced their backs and poked out through their chests, they stubbornly continued reciting the creed.
hunks.sol: Even with limbs cut off, even with arrowheads driven through their backs and jutting from their chests, the followers kept reciting the creed.

hunks.baseline: Until the very moment death fell over them.
hunks.sol: Right up to the moment death fell over them.

hunks.baseline: The Dark Heaven follower collapsed. He’d kept reciting the creed to the bitter end, even as blood poured from him. The Kunlun Sect Daoist who had stabbed him through the chest trembled, lips quivering.
hunks.sol: Only after forcing out the last words, blood pouring from him, did the Dark Heaven follower die. The Kunlun Sect Daoist who had stabbed him through the chest stood with trembling lips.

hunks.baseline: A wave of fanaticism beyond words.
hunks.sol: Fanaticism beyond words.

hunks.baseline: And there were fanatics like these everywhere, people who didn’t even fear death.
hunks.sol: And fanatics who didn’t even fear death were everywhere.

hunks.baseline: No—all the enemies, darkening this vast battlefield, were like that.
hunks.sol: No—every enemy darkening this vast battlefield was like that.

hunks.baseline: The one phrase someone managed to squeeze out was what everyone felt. It was steeped in the greatest fear and horror a person could feel.
hunks.sol: The words someone managed to squeeze out spoke for them all. They carried the utmost fear and horror a person could feel.

hunks.baseline: Weapons slipped from suddenly slack hands and sank into the mud.
hunks.sol: Weapons slipped from suddenly slack hands and fell into the mud.

hunks.baseline: For an instant, some of the Murim warriors and imperial troops lost their will to fight without even realizing it. Their trembling eyes stared blankly at the enemy.
hunks.sol: Some of the Murim warriors and imperial troops had lost their will to fight without even realizing it. They stared blankly at the enemy, eyes shaking.

hunks.baseline: They were afraid. Terrified to the point of shuddering.
hunks.sol: They were afraid. So afraid they shuddered.

hunks.baseline: Not of some huge, savage monster, but of those who looked just like them.
hunks.sol: Not of some huge, savage monster, but of people who looked just like them.

hunks.baseline: Those mad fanatics, stripped of the joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure every human being ought to feel, blindly following only the Lord of Heaven.
hunks.sol: Those mad fanatics, stripped of the joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure every human being ought to feel, who followed only the Lord of Heaven with blind devotion.

hunks.baseline: His soft sneer revealed a row of white teeth.
hunks.sol: A low, mocking laugh bared his white teeth.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, as the Blood Lord gently extended his fingertips, countless weapons that had been rolling across the ground rose upright.
hunks.sol: As the Blood Lord gently extended his hand, countless weapons lying on the ground rose upright.

hunks.baseline: Toward the enemies, frozen in place.
hunks.sol: Toward the enemies frozen in place.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of weapons tore through the air in an instant.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of weapons tore through the air at once.

hunks.baseline: A wave of steel surged through the ruins of the collapsed wall.
hunks.sol: A wave of steel swept through the ruins of the collapsed wall.

hunks.baseline: There was no choice left for those facing that blinding flash. They weren’t even granted time to close their eyes, let alone draw one last breath.
hunks.sol: Those facing that blinding flash had no choice left. They weren’t granted time to close their eyes, let alone draw one last breath.

hunks.baseline: And feel a streak of searing wind sweep over their heads.
hunks.sol: Then a streak of searing wind swept over their heads.

hunks.baseline: A heat so tremendous it was horrifying, dark blue light-flames, filled everyone’s sight.
hunks.sol: Terrifying heat and dark blue light-flames filled everyone’s sight.

hunks.baseline: They collided head-on.
Unleashing all the unimaginable power they held within them—the blinding light and rumbling force—into every corner of the battlefield.
hunks.sol: They struck each other head-on, unleashing the unimaginable power held within them in a burst of blinding light and sound.

hunks.baseline: Would this be the sound a fully awakened volcano made as it roared after a long sleep?
hunks.sol: Would a volcano, ripe to erupt and roaring awake from a long sleep, sound like this?

hunks.baseline: Or would a storm like this sweep over the land if an ancient giant exhaled with all its might?
hunks.sol: Would a storm like this sweep across the land if an ancient giant exhaled with all its might?

hunks.baseline: No one, that is, except the two people standing tall as iron towers in the fierce light and shock wave that heated and drove back everything within dozens of yards.
hunks.sol: No one except the two people standing tall as iron towers amid the fierce light and shock wave that heated and drove back everything for several dozen jang around them.

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord murmured and brought down the edge of his hand. The cloud of dust coiling around the western wall split apart in an instant, revealing what it had concealed.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord brought the edge of his hand down as he murmured. The dust cloud coiling around the western wall split apart, revealing what it had concealed.

hunks.baseline: A young man, drenched from head to toe in blood and rain, stood perfectly steady, aiming a pure silver-white spear at him.
hunks.sol: A young man drenched from head to toe in blood and rain stood without the slightest tremor, aiming a silver-white spear at him.

hunks.baseline: “That’s precisely why I can’t let you live.”
hunks.sol: “Which is precisely why I can’t let you live.”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord watched the young man, admiration in his voice.
hunks.sol: Admiration tinged the Blood Lord’s voice as he regarded the young man.

hunks.baseline: “Thanks for the surprise worship, but……”
hunks.sol: “Appreciate the sudden worship, but……”

hunks.baseline: He pulled out the shards of blades that had somehow pierced his body in several places as they flew through the wall of fire, then continued:
hunks.sol: Without hesitation, he pulled the fragments of sharp metal from where they had lodged in his body after piercing the wall of fire.

hunks.baseline: His voice was calm, but flames poured in streams from his eyes.
hunks.sol: His voice was calm. Flames streamed from his eyes.

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord gave a quiet laugh as he looked at him.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord wasn’t exaggerating.
hunks.sol: He wasn’t exaggerating.

hunks.baseline: Blood-red qi rose in wisps with every step.
hunks.sol: Blood-red qi rose in wisps with every step he took.

hunks.baseline: In the Blood Lord’s red-glinting eyes, only Jin Taekyung was clearly reflected.

hunks.baseline: “Is that so? Or is it just what you hope?”
hunks.sol: “Is that so? Or is that just what you hope?”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord stopped walking for an instant. Jin Taekyung’s voice slid into his ear.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord stopped. Jin Taekyung’s voice reached him clearly.

hunks.baseline: “You think he won’t understand. You think you’ll be screwed if you get caught. So you’re doing it first and hoping for the best. Even going so far as to send the Grand Mage far away, just in case.”
hunks.sol: “You don’t think he’ll understand. You think you’re screwed if he finds out, so you’re going ahead and doing it anyway. You even sent the Grand Mage far away, just in case.”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you staring at me like a rabbit caught in headlights? You look disgusting enough already. Anyone would think you’d just been slapped awake from the deepest sleep. Didn’t you already get a rough idea in your dream?”
hunks.sol: “Why are you staring at me with those rabbit eyes? You look disgusting enough already. Anyone would think you’d been slapped awake from a good night’s sleep. Hadn’t you already got a rough picture of it in your dream?”

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t Jin Taekyung’s relentless taunts that made him do it. It was the truth he’d tried to ignore, stabbing into his heart like an awl.
hunks.sol: Not because of Jin Taekyung’s relentless taunts, but because the truth he’d tried to ignore was driving into him like an awl.

hunks.baseline: “You know well enough, too. What your master—that damned Lord of Heaven—wants most.”
hunks.sol: “You know perfectly well what your master—that damned Lord of Heaven—wants most.”

hunks.baseline: The Blazing Flame Divine Dragon, Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: Blazing Flame Divine Dragon, Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: But everything that had led to this moment pointed to one painful truth.
hunks.sol: But everything that had led them here pointed to one painful truth.

hunks.baseline: It was more than a voice that burrowed into his ears. It was a truth that shook him to the core.

hunks.sol: “So go on. Try to kill me. If I can use you to screw over the Lord of Heaven, I don’t care what happens to me.”

hunks.baseline: As if it had always been part of him, from the distant past.
